scope.label: US CS ranking union — 61 schools with documented top-50 membership
scope.selectionRule: User requests union: include a US school if it ranks in the top 50 in any credible CS ranking system. Record ranking source, year, scope, and rank or verified top-50 membership separately.
scope.note: 61-school discovery seed: complete 53-school CSRankings USA/all-areas/2021–2026 top-50 subset including ties; Caltech from THE Computer Science 2026 worldwide #11; Notre Dame from CS Open Rankings 2026 aggregate #47; six additional schools from the Brown-hosted U.S. News column (original edition unspecified). Official UC 2025–26 U.S. News ranks supplement six schools. This is not an exhaustive union of every ranking system; preserve source scopes and edition caveats.

comparisonSources.name: CSRankings
comparisonSources.note: Verified directly in fully rendered browser; 53 institutions ranked <=50 including ties. No CSRankings code or publication dataset incorporated.

comparisonSources.name: U.S. News graduate Computer Science
comparisonSources.note: Original publisher table inaccessible in research tool. Six UC members supported by official 2025–26 university report. Six extra schools use the clearly labeled university-hosted CS Open Rankings report, whose original U.S. News edition is unspecified.

comparisonSources.name: CS Open Rankings
comparisonSources.note: Brown-hosted, updated 2026, default aggregate of U.S. News, faculty publications, placement and best-paper awards. Its publication implementation is different from CSRankings; never substitute its CSRankings-like column for the directly observed CSRankings ranks.

comparisonSources.name: Times Higher Education Computer Science 2026
comparisonSources.note: Caltech #11 worldwide. Worldwide top50 implies top50 among US institutions, but no US ordinal inferred.
